skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Shadow of the Dark Moon
skins.content: Witch Feast Role-Playing Script 'Grimoire of Dark Law' Custom Line/The Shadow of the Dark Moon. She plays the role of the witch guarding the grimoire. The tome is of no use to her. Instead, it is her sword that renders her unstoppable: 'Come, try to defeat me.'
skins.quote: It's rare to see Degenbrecher with such a furrowed brow and intense concentration on her face. After a long while, she finally finds the perfect angle, navigating the witch hat past her horns so it can sit atop her head. She breathes a sigh of relief.
